errors.generic: The action could not be completed.

editor.readOnly: You may not change this document; it is shown read-only.
editor.deleteBody: The draft is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

validation.fxRate: The rate must be greater than zero.
validation.dueBeforeDate: The due date cannot be before the document date.
validation.minReceiptLines: Enter a received quantity on at least one line.
validation.maxLines: A document may have at most {{max}} lines.
validation.quantityPositive: The quantity must be greater than zero.
validation.discount: The discount must be between 0 and 100.
validation.lot: Enter a lot number for a lot-tracked item.
validation.serialCount: The number of serials must equal the quantity.
validation.serialDuplicateShort: A serial was entered more than once.
validation.reason: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
validation.reverseDate: The reversal date cannot be before the document date.

match.title: Three-way match
match.noOrder: Not linked to an order; outside the match.
match.offHint: Matching is off: variances do not affect booking.

book.title: Book the invoice
book.body: The invoice is numbered and a journal entry is posted: the goods-received accrual is cleared, price differences go to their own account, VAT to input VAT and withholding to its own line.
book.numberRequired: Booking needs the supplier invoice number; enter it in the draft and save.
book.warnMode: The match has variances. In warn mode the invoice is booked anyway and the variance is noted.
book.blockOverride: The match has variances in block mode. To book, approve the variance with a reason; the reason is recorded in the audit trail.
book.blockNoRight: The match has variances in block mode and you may not approve variances. Correct the invoice or pass it to an authorised user.
book.reasonShort: The reason needs at least {{min}} characters.

reverse.title: Reverse {{number}}
reverse.body: The invoice's journal entry is closed with a reversing entry. Invoices with payments or returns cannot be reversed.
reverse.stock: Also cancel goods received by this invoice
reverse.stockHint: Only the goods receipts this invoice created itself are cancelled.

invoice.listDescription: Supplier invoices and debit notes with balance due and match state.
invoice.editorDescription: Lines are entered directly or come from goods receipts and orders; booking runs the three-way match.
invoice.cancelBody: The invoice awaiting approval is cancelled; nothing has been posted.
invoice.pendingApproval: The invoice awaits approval; it is booked automatically once approved.
invoice.supplierNoHint: Unique per supplier; required for booking.
invoice.receiveOnInvoiceHint: {{count}} stock lines have no goods receipt; one is created automatically on booking.

receipt.listDescription: Goods received against orders or directly, with lots, serials and expiry dates.
receipt.editorDescription: Enter received quantities with lot, expiry and serials; posting receives the stock at the order cost.
receipt.directDescription: A receipt without an order can be saved only if the company setting allows it.
receipt.splitHint: Split the line to receive the same order line in several lots.
receipt.serialsBody: Type or scan one serial number per row.
receipt.postBody: The document is numbered, stock is received at the order cost and the goods-received-not-invoiced accrual is booked.
receipt.postTracked: {{count}} lines are received with lots or serials.
receipt.cancelBody: The draft is cancelled; there is no stock movement.
receipt.reverseBody: The stock receipt and the accrual are reversed. Invoiced or returned receipts cannot be reversed.
receipt.invoiceBody: A draft invoice is created with every line not invoiced yet; quantities and prices are edited on the invoice.

return.listDescription: Goods sent back to suppliers, with approval, shipping and debit note steps.
return.fromInvoiceHint: Return from the lines of a booked invoice; a debit note follows shipping.
return.fromReceiptHint: Return from a goods receipt not invoiced; it ends with shipping.
return.pickSource: Start the return from a supplier invoice or a goods receipt.
return.selectSome: Enter a return quantity on at least one line.
return.receiptEndsShipped: A return from a goods receipt ends with shipping; no debit note is issued.

confirm.approve: The return is numbered and ready to ship.
confirm.ship: The goods leave stock; the difference between receipt cost and valuation is corrected to the price variance account.
confirm.debit: A debit note reducing the payable and the VAT is issued and booked.
confirm.cancel: The return is cancelled; no stock or accounting movement is created.
